# WWDC26 session notes

> LLM-written digests of 100+ WWDC 2026 sessions, plus Apple's verbatim transcripts, session metadata, and Code-tab snippets. One folder per session under `sessions/`, named `{number}-{slug}`.

Each folder contains `digest.md` (the summary, linked below), `transcript.md` (Apple's full transcript), `meta.md` (description, key topics, chapter summary), and `code.md` (Code-tab snippets; some sessions have none). The frontmatter of every file carries the URL of its source page on developer.apple.com. Read the digest first; open the transcript for exact wording or full context.

## Sessions

- [102 · Platforms State of the Union](sessions/102-platforms-state-of-the-union/digest.md): The Platforms State of the Union: Apple Intelligence and Foundation Models, Liquid Glass refinements, resizable iPhone apps, SwiftUI updates, Swift 6.4, and agentic coding in Xcode 27.
- [121 · Announcing Apple's next big step for Siri and iPhone](sessions/121-announcing-apple-next-big/digest.md): A one-minute movie-trailer teaser for the year's headline Siri and iPhone features.
- [122 · WWDC26 Platforms State of the Union Recap](sessions/122-wwdc26-platforms-state-union/digest.md): A five-minute recap of the Platforms State of the Union: intelligence, platforms, and tools.
- [201 · Secure your apps with App Attest](sessions/201-secure-apps-app-attest/digest.md): How App Attest protects your app and users against fraud.
- [203 · Read between the strokes with PencilKit](sessions/203-read-between-strokes-pencilkit/digest.md): The PencilKit APIs behind handwriting in Notes and Freeform, now open to your apps in the 27 releases.
- [204 · What's new in WebKit for Safari 27](sessions/204-webkit-safari-27/digest.md): What Safari 27 brings to the web platform.
- [205 · Enhance your presence on the App Store](sessions/205-enhance-presence-app-store/digest.md): New ways to use images and video to shape your app's first impression on the App Store.
- [206 · What's new in managing Apple devices](sessions/206-managing-apple-devices/digest.md): What's new across declarative device management, app management, identity integrations, and education.
- [207 · Deliver workout insights with HealthKit workout zones](sessions/207-deliver-workout-insights-healthkit/digest.md): HealthKit workout zones turn biometric data into training guidance on effort and intensity.
- [209 · What's new in Wallet](sessions/209-what-s-new-wallet/digest.md): What's new in Wallet for iOS 27.
- [210 · What's new in Apple In-App Purchase](sessions/210-apple-app-purchase/digest.md): Expanded subscription pricing, offer code API updates, and an improved App Store Connect submission flow.
- [212 · Rev up your CarPlay app](sessions/212-rev-up-carplay-app/digest.md): What's new in CarPlay for iOS 27.
- [213 · Translate your app using agents in Xcode](sessions/213-translate-app-agents-xcode/digest.md): Translate your app's strings in Xcode 27 using coding agents.
- [215 · Get started with the HTML Model Element](sessions/215-started-html-model-element/digest.md): The HTML model element adds 3D content to a page the way img adds images.
- [216 · Create web extensions for Safari](sessions/216-web-extensions-safari/digest.md): Safari web extensions built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript run across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS from one project.
- [219 · Enhance the accessibility of your reading app](sessions/219-enhance-accessibility-reading-app/digest.md): Making long-form text and reading apps accessible across Apple platforms.
- [220 · Refine accessibility for custom controls](sessions/220-refine-accessibility-custom-controls/digest.md): Making custom controls and their gestures accessible.
- [221 · Prepare your tvOS apps for Dynamic Type](sessions/221-prepare-tvos-apps-dynamic/digest.md): System-wide Large Text support on tvOS 27 and how apps scale text for it.
- [222 · Meet the new MetricKit](sessions/222-meet-new-metrickit/digest.md): MetricKit's new API for monitoring real-world app performance on real devices.
- [223 · Live Activities essentials](sessions/223-live-activities-essentials/digest.md): Live Activities essentials: data model, presentations, updates, and every surface from Lock Screen to CarPlay.
- [224 · Expand the capabilities of your Virtualization app](sessions/224-expand-capabilities-virtualization-app/digest.md): New Virtualization framework APIs: macOS guest provisioning, USB accessory passthrough, advanced networking, DiskImageKit layered disk images, and custom Virtio devices.
- [226 · Create live communication experiences](sessions/226-live-communication-experiences/digest.md): LiveCommunicationKit, the modern way to build call and live-conversation experiences that integrate with the system.
- [227 · Create UI prototypes using agents in Xcode](sessions/227-ui-prototypes-agents-xcode/digest.md): Prototyping UI with Xcode's coding agents and Swift previews.
- [230 · What's new in assessment on macOS](sessions/230-assessment-macos/digest.md): Enhancements to the Automatic Assessment Configuration framework in macOS 27.
- [232 · Run local agentic AI on the Mac using MLX](sessions/232-run-local-agentic-ai/digest.md): Build and run agentic AI workflows on a Mac with MLX, no cloud or API keys required.
- [233 · Explore distributed inference and training with MLX](sessions/233-distributed-inference-training-mlx/digest.md): Distributed inference and training with MLX when one machine runs out of memory or compute.
- [234 · Design immersive environments for visionOS apps and the spatial web](sessions/234-immersive-environments-visionos-apps/digest.md): Designing photo-realistic immersive environments for visionOS apps and the spatial web.
- [237 · What's new in image understanding](sessions/237-image-understanding/digest.md): New image understanding across Vision and Foundation Models: tap-to-segment, image inputs for LLMs, image-based tool calling, and Vision on watchOS.
- [240 · Build intelligent Siri experiences with App Schemas](sessions/240-intelligent-siri-experiences-app/digest.md): How App Intents and App Schemas bring your app to a more capable, contextual Siri.
- [241 · What's new in the Foundation Models framework](sessions/241-foundation-models/digest.md): The year's Foundation Models framework updates, including image input and server models.
- [242 · Build agentic app experiences with the Foundation Models framework](sessions/242-agentic-app-experiences-foundation/digest.md): Dynamic Profiles, the declarative agentic API in the Foundation Models framework.
- [243 · Debug and profile agentic app experiences with Instruments](sessions/243-debug-profile-agentic-app/digest.md): Debug and profile agentic features with the Foundation Models template in Instruments.
- [246 · LLM search using Core Spotlight](sessions/246-llm-search-core-spotlight/digest.md): Conversational search by exposing your app's content to a language model through Core Spotlight.
- [250 · Principles of great design](sessions/250-principles-great/digest.md): A non-technical talk on what great design means on Apple platforms.
- [251 · Communicate your brand identity on iOS](sessions/251-communicate-brand-identity-ios/digest.md): Balancing brand expression with the familiar paradigms of iOS.
- [252 · Design no-code games with Reality Composer Pro 3](sessions/252-no-code-games-reality/digest.md): Designing and building games in Reality Composer Pro 3 without writing code.
- [253 · Meet the Music Understanding framework](sessions/253-music-understanding-framework/digest.md): The Music Understanding framework brings on-device, offline musical intelligence to Apple platforms.
- [254 · Integrate MusicKit into your app](sessions/254-integrate-musickit-app/digest.md): An introduction to MusicKit, building a music-enhanced workout app with Swift concurrency and SwiftUI.
- [256 · Discover generated subtitles and subtitle styles](sessions/256-generated-subtitles-subtitle-styles/digest.md): Apple's AI-generated subtitles, created live and on-device as media plays, plus subtitle styles.
- [258 · What's new in Xcode 27](sessions/258-xcode-27/digest.md): A guided tour of Xcode 27 across the full app lifecycle.
- [259 · Xcode, agents, and you](sessions/259-xcode-agents/digest.md): An overview of coding agents in Xcode 27.
- [260 · Get the most out of Device Hub](sessions/260-most-out-device-hub/digest.md): Device Hub, the new home for physical devices and simulators alongside Xcode 27.
- [261 · Build, deliver, and automate with Xcode Cloud](sessions/261-deliver-automate-xcode-cloud/digest.md): Building, delivering, and automating with Xcode Cloud.
- [262 · What's new in Swift](sessions/262-what-s-new-swift/digest.md): Swift 6.3 and 6.4: language improvements, library updates, C and Java interop, WebAssembly, embedded, and performance tuning.

- [279 · Explore advances in RealityKit](sessions/279-advances-realitykit/digest.md): The latest advances in RealityKit across visionOS, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and tvOS.

- [282 · Discover the Spatial Preview framework](sessions/282-spatial-preview-framework/digest.md): The Spatial Preview framework extends a Mac app's content into visionOS over Mac Virtual Display.
- [283 · Explore enhancements to visionOS object tracking](sessions/283-enhancements-visionos-object-tracking/digest.md): New object tracking and spatial accessory capabilities in visionOS 27.
- [284 · Collaborate on structured 3D models in visionOS](sessions/284-collaborate-structured-3d-models/digest.md): Collaborative spatial experiences on Vision Pro for complex 3D assemblies.
- [285 · Discover USDKit and what's new in OpenUSD](sessions/285-usdkit-openusd/digest.md): USDKit and OpenUSD updates for USD, the scene representation behind Apple's spatial experiences.
- [286 · Use foveated streaming to bring immersive content to visionOS](sessions/286-foveated-streaming-bring-immersive/digest.md): Foveated Streaming lets Vision Pro stream immersive OpenXR content rendered on an external device such as a PC.
